name: 维卡尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4040
who: Vikar, a winged demon, lord of the wing-hosts south of the line, a legend who has looked about thirty-eight ever since the night his name was made more than a thousand years ago: tall, about 190 cm, lean and light-boned with very broad shoulder blades. Glossy blue-black raven hair grown long and plaited into one thick braid that hangs forward over his chest. Violet eyes. He has NO working wings: on his back are two short wing stumps, a matched pair, one on each side, each only the length of a forearm, bone and a few blue-black feathers at the root, ending in a burnt-off edge ringed with a gold burn scar that glows faintly even in the dark. No horns, ordinary ears, no jewelry. A quiet, weighty air, always looking up for the highest point in sight.
build: 190 cm, tall and lean: very broad, strong shoulder blades and back, long sinewy arms, narrow hips, light bones.
palette: raven blue-black, violet, burnt gold, night grey, bone white
casual: His everyday wear south of the line: a sleeveless high-collared jerkin of dark grey-blue leather, cut away low at the back so that both wing stumps stand bare, over a long-sleeved black linen shirt opened at the back the same way, dark trousers and soft climbing boots wrapped at the ankle. Hanging at the small of his back from a leather belt are two curved climbing hooks of pale bone, ground from his own burnt wing bones, each the length of a forearm with a pointed tip and a leather-wrapped grip, NOT swords. He stands upright with his arms folded, looking up, a calm, measuring look.
private: Resting among his wing-host at night: no jerkin, a loose long-sleeved black linen shirt open at the back for the stumps, a dark grey wool blanket thrown over one shoulder, dark trousers, barefoot, the braid loose over the chest. He holds a leather water skin in one hand, a quiet, tired, gentle look.
battle: Climbing the beacon tower as a legend, in the war harness of the wing-hosts' lord: a long close-fitting coat of blackened scale armour reaching the shins, every scale a thin plate of polished black obsidian edged with carved pale bone, high-collared, the back left open in a wide V so that the two gold-scarred wing stumps blaze bright; layered obsidian shoulder plates rimmed with bone and etched with night-script that glows faint violet; black bone-plated bracers and greaves carved with the same violet lines. He holds one pale bone climbing hook in each hand, the points turned down, their edges glowing faint gold, and a pool of starless night clings around his feet like black water, trailing upward behind his heels in thin dark sheets. A heavy, upward-reaching stance, a cold, unblinking look.
formal: Before the gathered wing-host at dusk: a long violet-black wool coat that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, the back cut open for the stumps, a wide belt of plaited dark leather, a row of small dark feathers of fallen kin tied along the left lapel (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the braid freshly plaited, the two bone hooks hanging at the small of his back. He stands very straight with his hands at his sides, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the violet eyes lifted past the viewer toward something high above, the mouth closed. The only light is the warm gold glow of the burn scars on his wing stumps behind his shoulders, with cold dark night all around and no stars. Foreground blur: drifting ash, a few falling blue-black feathers and the pale point of a bone hook. He wears the dark grey-blue leather jerkin.
battle_old: Climbing the beacon tower as a legend: a long close-fitting coat of blackened scale-and-leather armour reaching the shins, high-collared, the back cut open in a wide V so that the two gold-scarred wing stumps blaze bright, overlapping dark plates on the shoulders edged with pale bone, black leather bracers and greaves. He holds one pale bone climbing hook in each hand, the points turned down, and a pool of starless night clings around his feet like black water, trailing upward behind his heels in thin dark sheets. A heavy, upward-reaching stance, a cold, unblinking look.
gear: 传奇（撼世，约LVL 210）｜富｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇、线南翼群的头领，定在这一纪顶上那一档；魔族不烧魔晶，照有翼一系用黑曜、骨和夜里发亮的刻文，翼骨磨的钩子照旧。

name: 奥伊拉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4061
who: Oira, a deep-tide sea demon, lead-ship tide-master of the tide-master family outside the Salt Sea Gate, seventy-four years old with a face of twenty-six or twenty-seven, fixed on the night her name was made: about 172 cm, slender and strong from swimming. Sea-teal hair in dozens of thin braids, a small broken seashell hanging from each braid tip. Coral-red eyes. A pair of horns lying close along the temples and curving back past the ears, a ring of white salt frost crusted at each root. Fine silver-teal scales from behind the ears down the sides of the neck, thin half-webs between the fingers. Pale skin with a faint cool sea tint. One old vertical scar down the middle of the lower lip, cut by a conch's lip. No earrings, no jewelry. A calm, unhurried, weighty air; she counts time in tides.
build: 172 cm, slender and strong: straight shoulders, a long swimmer's back, a B-cup, a narrow waist and long legs.
palette: sea teal, coral red, conch white, salt-frost white, deep kelp green
casual: Her tide-master's wear on the lead ship: a long sleeveless overcoat of deep kelp-green linen woven with seaweed fibre, salt-stained at the hem and slit at both sides, over a close-fitting long-sleeved dark sea-blue shirt and dark trousers rolled to the calf, a wide sash of faded coral red, barefoot. At her hip a white conch shell as long as her forearm hangs from a cord threaded with a long row of sixty-eight small shell plates. She stands with one webbed hand resting on the conch, looking past the viewer, a calm look.
private: On board between tides: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen tunic to the knees belted with a rope, the braids pulled together and tied back with a cord, barefoot. She holds a leather water skin out in front of her as if handing it to someone, a quiet, attentive look.
battle: On the prow on the night of the great double tide, in the tide-master family's heirloom war shell: a fitted armour of overlapping pearl-white shell plates over dark sea-green scale-mail, each plate inlaid with spiralling tide-script that glows sea-green, high-collared, the shoulder plates shaped like great spiral shells rimmed with white salt crystal, long sleeves with shell-plated vambraces, a long split skirt of scale panels edged with mother-of-pearl, a long deep-teal mantle that streams out behind her like a rising wave, its edge foaming white with drifting spray-light. She holds the white conch raised to her scarred lips in both webbed hands, the cord of sixty-eight shell plates swinging from it, each plate glinting. A tall, still, commanding stance, the coral-red eyes cold and steady.
formal: At the tide-masters' council: a long deep sea-blue robe that closes down the front with shell buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem embroidered with a band of silver wave lines, a coral-red sash, a short cape of salt-white wool over the shoulders, the braids gathered up and pinned with small shells, barefoot; the conch hangs at her hip on its cord of shell plates. She stands straight with her hands folded in front, a calm, level look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the coral-red eyes looking at the viewer with a calm, heavy look, the mouth closed with the lip scar showing. Cold blue night light from above, a pale sea-green glow from below like light through deep water. Foreground blur: salt spray, drifting shell flakes and the white rim of the conch. She wears the kelp-green tide-master's overcoat.
battle_old: On the prow on the night of the great double tide: a fitted armour of overlapping pearl-white shell plates over dark sea-green scale-mail, high-collared, shoulder plates shaped like spiral shells, long sleeves with shell-plated vambraces, a long split skirt of scale panels, a long deep-teal mantle that streams out behind her like a rising wave, its edge foaming white, the shell plates glowing faintly sea-green. She holds the white conch raised to her scarred lips in both webbed hands, the cord of sixty-eight shell plates swinging from it. A tall, still, commanding stance, the coral-red eyes cold and steady.
gear: 英雄→传奇（倒潮夜第二声螺到撼世）｜世家｜照常｜5档｜倒潮夜这一格正是她到传奇的那一刻，潮主家世代领船，贝甲是家传的，升到顶档，加潮文、盐晶和浪光。

name: 蕾翁娜
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4084
who: Leona, a winged demon woman, lead wing of the cliff-nest host above the southern border, about a hundred years old and looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 170 cm, lean and light-boned. Night-blue long hair braided into a row of thin braids lying close against her head and running back past the shoulder blades, a pair of small horns growing back along the braids. Pale violet eyes. A pair of large iron-blue-grey feathered wings that stand taller than she is even when folded; the edge of the LEFT wing is missing a row of flight feathers (on the viewer's right when she faces us), the right wing whole. At her throat on a cord a whistle carved from her own first shed wing bone. She never quite folds her wings and stands up on the balls of her feet. A keen, wind-reading air. No earrings, no jewelry.
build: 170 cm, lean and light: straight strong shoulders and back for the wings, a B-cup, a narrow waist, long legs.
palette: iron blue-grey, night blue, pale violet, bone white, soot black
casual: Her flight gear at the cliff nest: a close-fitting dark grey leather flight jerkin with a high collar and the back cut open between the wing roots, laced at the sides, long sleeves of soot-black wool, dark fitted trousers and soft wrapped boots, a narrow belt with a small knife. The bone whistle hangs at her throat. She stands up on her toes with the wings half spread, one hand shading her eyes as she looks up into the wind, a keen look.
private: Resting in the cliff nest: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic open at the back for the wings, wrapped with a dark sash, soft leggings, barefoot, the wings folded loosely around her like a cloak. She holds one long grey feather up to the light, turning it in her fingers, a quiet look.
battle: Diving on the sky-tower, in the lead wing's war harness: a fitted flight armour of dark iron-blue scale-leather, overlapping plates of pale carved bone over the chest and shoulders cut with wind-script that glows faint violet-white, a high bone gorget, bracers and greaves of black leather set with thin obsidian splints, the back open between the wing roots; the bone whistle hangs at her throat; the great iron-blue wings spread wide behind her, the left one missing its row of feathers. She grips a long bone spear in both hands, its head ground needle-sharp and its shaft bound with violet-lit script, the point thrust down and forward as if she is about to drop like a black star. A fierce, cold, intent look.
formal: Before the wing-host at the cliff nest: a long night-blue wool coat that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, open at the back between the wing roots, a soot-black sash, the braids freshly re-plaited, the bone whistle at her throat, the wings folded high. She stands straight with her hands clasped behind her, a level, proud look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking past the viewer up into the wind, the lips closed, the bone whistle at her throat. Hard cold dawn light from above and one side catches the iron-blue feathers. Foreground blur: drifting soot, a torn grey feather and smoke. She wears the dark grey leather flight jerkin.
battle_old: Diving on the sky-tower: a fitted flight armour of dark iron-blue scale-leather, pale bone plates over the chest and shoulders, bracers and greaves wrapped with black leather, the back open between the wing roots, the great iron-blue wings spread wide behind her, the left one missing its row of feathers. She grips a long bone spear in both hands, the point thrust down and forward as if she is about to drop like a black star. A fierce, cold, intent look.
gear: 英雄（约LVL 165）｜中｜照常｜4档｜英雄位阶的领翼，英雄往上不看家境；照浮塔年月夜翼扑塔、骨矛钉塔那一路，骨甲刻风文，翼骨磨的哨挂上。

name: 裴洛森
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4109
who: Pelosen, a nightmare-line demon of the fog paths outside the southern end of the wall, leader of a clan of tens of thousands, a hundred and forty-odd years old and looking just past thirty: about 183 cm, tall and slender. Long smoky lilac-grey hair tied loosely at the nape. A pair of thin horns curving back. Eyes of burning orange-gold like a lit lamp wick. Cold white skin, the pallor of one raised in fog. He always goes barefoot. His shadow lags half a step behind him. In his hand an old lantern with brightly polished glass and a new wick that has never been lit. A soft-voiced, patient, melancholy air; he speaks quietly and is heard across water. No jewelry.
build: 183 cm, tall and slender: long limbs, narrow shoulders, long pale hands and feet.
palette: smoky lilac, fog grey, cold white, lamp orange-gold, tarnished brass
casual: His everyday wear on the fog paths: a long fog-grey wool coat that closes down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem fraying into thin wisps, over a dark lilac-grey shirt buttoned to the throat, loose dark trousers rolled at the ankle, barefoot. He holds the old lantern by its ring in his left hand, its glass polished and its wick unlit, a quiet, patient look.
private: In his clan's tents: a loose long-sleeved dove-grey linen tunic, a dark grey knitted shawl, dark trousers, barefoot, the hair loose over one shoulder. He cups a small lit clay oil lamp in both hands, a soft, tired smile.
battle: Raising the false lamps in the fog, in a fog-walker's ward coat rather than armour: the long fog-grey coat closed with carved horn buttons, its collar and cuffs sewn with small shards of black obsidian mirror that catch the orange-gold light, under a dark lilac mantle whose edges fray into drifting mist and whose lining is stitched with faint lamp-script glowing orange; a fitted dark leather vest and bracers beneath, a cord of small bone lamp-charms at the belt, barefoot. In his left hand he holds the old unlit lantern raised high; his right hand is open at his side, and around him float a dozen small glowing orange-gold lights with no lamps, like lit windows hanging in the air. A calm, still, persuasive look, the orange-gold eyes glowing.
formal: Speaking for his clan: a long dark lilac-grey robe that closes down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a band of pale silver-grey embroidery like curling fog at the hem and cuffs, a fog-grey sash, the hair combed and tied neatly at the nape, barefoot; the old lantern hangs from his left hand. He stands straight with his free hand open, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the orange-gold eyes looking at the viewer with a soft, patient, sorrowful look, the mouth closed. He stands on still lake water at night, the thin horns dark against pale fog, and countless small orange-gold false lamps float in the fog behind him. Foreground blur: drifting fog and the polished glass of his unlit lantern. He wears the fog-grey coat.
battle_old: Raising the false lamps in the fog: the long fog-grey coat under a dark lilac mantle whose edges fray into drifting mist, a fitted dark leather vest and bracers beneath, barefoot. In his left hand he holds the old unlit lantern raised high; his right hand is open at his side, and around him float a dozen small glowing orange-gold lights with no lamps, like lit windows hanging in the air. A calm, still, persuasive look, the orange-gold eyes glowing.
gear: 英雄（约LVL 155）｜贫｜法袍｜4档｜英雄定在四档，可他是点灯引路的梦魇，不靠甲，赤脚，照他的路子把档用在雾衣上：黑曜镜片、灯文衬里、骨制灯符。

name: 纳兹罗
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4130
who: Nazro, a long-lived demon-kin priest who stands before the high seat of the Wolf Pack that Devours Itself and chooses and shares out the feast bowl, eleven hundred years old and looking about thirty-two: about 180 cm, tall and spare. Long smoky plum-violet hair bound in one tail at the nape. Very pale silver-green eyes, almost white, that glow at night only as faintly as one distant lamp. Cool pale skin. He has NO horns at all and no scales: the long-lived line is smooth-browed, with ordinary ears only faintly pointed at the tips. A white scald scar on the inside of each thumb from bowl rims. At the small of his back a long-handled black iron ladle, its handle worn thin by his hand. A slow-spoken, gentle, unyielding air. No jewelry.
build: 180 cm, tall and spare: narrow shoulders, a straight back, long pale hands.
palette: ash grey, plum violet, dark blood red, black iron, pale silver-green
casual: His priest's wear in the war-camp: a long ash-grey robe that closes down the front with plain buttons, wide sleeves turned back at the cuff, a narrow dark blood-red band down the front, a plain dark leather belt, soft boots; the long black iron ladle hangs at the small of his back. He stands holding an empty clay bowl in both hands, the white thumb scars showing on its rim, a gentle, attentive look.
private: In a tent of the long-lived after the feast: a plain undyed grey linen tunic with the sleeves rolled, a dark knitted shawl, soft shoes, the hair loose. He holds a short length of plain cuff ribbon between his fingers as if about to tie someone's sleeve, the head bowed, a quiet, careful look.
battle: Walking at the head of the feast on the night of the eighth feast: the ash-grey robe under a long black hooded mantle lined with deep crimson, a wide black leather belt, black leather bracers. He holds the long black iron ladle out level in front of him in his right hand like a sceptre, the left hand raised open, and thin threads of dark red horn-fire curl around the ladle. A calm, sorrowful, unbending look.
battle_pose: 3) the feast-night outfit: standing straight and unhurried, the feet together, holding the long black iron ladle out level in front of him in one hand, the other hand raised open, a calm, sorrowful, unbending expression; he is a priest and carries no weapon.
formal: Before the high seat at the feast: a long black robe that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a wide blood-red stole embroidered with a row of small bowl shapes in dull silver thread, the hair bound neatly. He holds a wide shallow bowl of dark bronze in both hands before his chest. He stands very straight, grave and gentle.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale silver-green eyes looking at the viewer with a gentle, steady, tired look, the mouth closed. Low red firelight from below, cold dark blue all around. Foreground blur: steam rising from a bowl and the rim of the black iron ladle. He wears the ash-grey priest's robe.
battle_old: Walking at the head of the feast on the night of the eighth feast: the ash-grey robe under a long black hooded mantle lined with blood red, a wide black leather belt, black leather bracers. He holds the long black iron ladle out level in front of him in his right hand like a sceptre, the left hand raised open, and thin threads of dark red horn-fire curl around the ladle. A calm, sorrowful, unbending look.
gear: 极境（6720年约LVL 96）｜中｜法袍｜3档｜座前祭司，不是兵，不带兵器，第三格照 battle_pose 出宴夜那一身；battle 照原句交回，只把衬里的 blood red 换成 deep crimson 免得过审核。

name: 葛丽泽
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4151
who: Grize, a human woman of a forge-smith family of the Furnace City, ninth pilot of the great walking war-machine called the City Ridge, sixty-nine and looking about thirty: about 168 cm, compact and strong. Orange-gold hair cut short above the ears. Blue-violet eyes. A spray of freckles across the bridge of her nose. On both forearms faint pale-blue rune marks glow under the skin, from years soaked in the light of a magic furnace core. Fair skin. No earrings, no jewelry. A brisk, practical, warm air; she talks about her machine like an old house.
build: 168 cm, compact and strong: square shoulders, strong forearms, a C-cup, a firm waist and sturdy legs.
palette: orange gold, blue violet, furnace charcoal, rune blue, oiled brass
casual: Her everyday wear at the Furnace City works: a charcoal wool work jacket with the sleeves rolled to the elbow so the rune marks on both forearms show, a thick canvas shirt, a heavy leather apron pocked with spark holes, dark trousers tucked into heavy boots, a brass-capped wrench at the belt. She holds a wax tally board under one arm, a brisk, cheerful look.
private: On leave behind the wall: a loose long-sleeved cream linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a knitted wool vest, plain trousers, soft shoes. She holds a steaming mug of hot cider in both hands, a relaxed, tired smile.
battle: Strapped in as pilot of the City Ridge, in the Furnace City pilot's war kit: a thick padded charcoal wool under-armour quilted with copper rune-thread that glows faint blue, leather at the elbows and knees; over it a fitted brass-riveted enchanted harness of thin plates across the chest and shoulders, crystal-lit brass couplings at both shoulders where the machine's link-clamps lock on, a row of crystal cells at the belt; short leather gauntlets that leave the forearms bare so the rune marks glow bright blue; a close leather cap with smoked mica goggles pushed up on the forehead, heavy boots. In her right hand she holds a heavy brass rune-key as long as her forearm, the start-key of the machine's furnace core, glowing blue along its teeth. A firm, focused look.
formal: At the roll of the great machines: a clean charcoal wool coat of the Furnace City buttoned to the throat, a short orange-red sash, a small brass cog pin at the collar, polished boots, the short hair combed. She stands with her hands at her sides, a proud, slightly awkward smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-violet eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, unblinking look, the mouth closed. Cold blue rune light from below, from the pilot's controls, and warm furnace orange from behind. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the curve of a goggle lens. She wears the padded pilot's under-armour with the goggles pushed up.
battle_old: Strapped in as pilot of the City Ridge: a thick padded charcoal wool under-armour with leather sewn at the elbows and knees, a fitted brass-buckled pilot's harness across the chest and shoulders, short leather gauntlets that leave the forearms bare so the rune marks glow bright blue, a close leather cap with smoked mica goggles pushed up on the forehead, heavy boots. In her right hand she holds a heavy brass rune-key as long as her forearm, the start-key of the machine's furnace core, glowing blue along its teeth. A firm, focused look.
gear: 英雄｜中｜照常｜4档｜极限型机甲城脊的主控，英雄位阶，炉城炉匠家出身；她的战装是驾驶的那一身，升成量身做的主控挽具，铜接口、晶匣、符文线，起动钥照旧。

name: 塔赫尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4167
who: Taher, a flame-horn demon, leader of the enemy vanguard facing the South Seven wall, a hero whose name is made, sixty-two years old and fixed at the look of forty: about 194 cm, huge, broad and heavy. Short slate blue-grey hair. A pair of thick horns curving forward, the flame on them burnt to pure white. Orange-copper eyes. Dull brick-red skin, the flame-horn colour. Both lower legs from the feet up to the knees are baked hard to the colour of fired clay, paler than the rest of him and crazed with fine cracks like pottery. He never wears boots and always goes barefoot. A blunt, steady, earth-minded air; most of what he says is about the ground. No jewelry.
build: 194 cm, huge and heavy: broad shoulders, a deep chest, thick arms and thick legs.
palette: white flame, brick red, slate blue-grey, orange copper, obsidian black, fired-clay ochre
casual: His vanguard wear outside the wall: a red-bronze breastplate over a dark sleeveless undershirt, both arms bare to the shoulder, a wide belt of black leather, dark leather breeches cut off at the knee so the baked, cracked lower legs show, barefoot. He stands with his feet planted wide as if testing the ground, one big hand open at his side, the white flames on his horns burning low.
private: By the camp fire: no breastplate, a loose dark sleeveless linen shirt, dark breeches to the knee, barefoot, a rough wool blanket over one shoulder. He holds a clay cup of water, the white horn flames low, a quiet, heavy look.
battle: Leading the push on the breach, in the flame-horn vanguard's war gear: a massive red-bronze breastplate etched with branching copper sorcery lines that glow white-hot, both arms bare to the shoulder, heavy pauldrons of black leather studded with black obsidian, red-bronze bracers, a short war kilt of riveted leather strips plated with red bronze, barefoot on the cracked baked legs. In his right hand a long-hafted war axe with a black obsidian head, white fire running along its edge; his left hand is held open toward the ground and glows white-hot, the horn flames roaring up white. A grim, immovable look.
formal: At a war-band muster: the red-bronze breastplate polished, a heavy dark red wool cloak pinned at one shoulder, a black leather belt with a bronze buckle, barefoot. He stands planted with the obsidian-headed axe grounded at his side, a grave, level look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the orange-copper eyes looking at the viewer with a heavy, steady look, the mouth closed. Hard white light from the white flames on his horns above, a dull red glow from cracked baked earth below. Foreground blur: drifting ash and heat shimmer over hardened mud. He wears the red-bronze breastplate with bare arms.
battle_old: Leading the push on the breach: the red-bronze breastplate etched with branching copper sorcery lines, heavy black-leather pauldrons, leather bracers, a short war kilt of riveted leather strips, barefoot on the cracked baked legs. In his right hand a long-hafted war axe with a black obsidian head; his left hand is held open toward the ground and glows white-hot, the horn flames roaring up white. A grim, immovable look.
gear: 英雄（约LVL 188，名字凝住）｜中｜照常｜4档｜名字凝住的英雄、前锋领头，照浮塔年月炎角赤铜胸甲光膀子那一身往上做，黑曜镶钉、刻纹透白火，黑曜斧照旧，照旧赤脚。

name: 瑟娜缇
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4188
who: Senati, a shadow-demon woman of the nightmare line, a named hero of the flame-horn vanguard, fifty-four years old and fixed at the look of thirty-two: about 170 cm, slender and lithe. Glossy blue-black hair hanging straight down to the backs of her knees. Indigo-violet eyes. A pair of small fine horns on her forehead, each only the length of a little finger. Cool ash-pale skin. In daylight there is no shadow at her feet; her shadow is always somewhere else, and when it comes back it is longer than she is. A quiet, flat-voiced, watchful air. No earrings, no jewelry.
build: 170 cm, slender and lithe: narrow shoulders, a B-cup, a small waist, long legs.
palette: blue-black, indigo violet, ash pale, shadow grey, a little dull silver
casual: Her wear in the vanguard camp: a long close-fitting dark slate-grey coat that closes down the front with small dull silver buttons, fitted sleeves, slit high at the sides for walking, over dark fitted trousers and soft silent boots, a narrow black sash. The knee-length hair hangs loose down her back. She stands still with her hands at her sides, glancing to one side as if checking where the light comes from, a calm, watchful look.
private: At night in the camp: a loose long-sleeved charcoal linen tunic to the knee, soft dark trousers, barefoot, the long hair loosely plaited once. She holds a folded dark blanket over one arm, a quiet, gentle look.
battle: Sending her shadow across the breach, in a shadow-walker's silent war kit: the close dark slate coat belted tight under a fitted harness of black leather with thin matte obsidian plates at the shoulders and ribs that swallow the light, nothing that can jingle, black leather bracers set with dull obsidian splints, soft silent boots. Her shadow has left her and rises beside her as a long flat black silhouette of a woman taller than she is, its long thin fingers reaching forward; her own right hand is raised with the fingers spread, steering it, the left hand low at her side. A cold, intent, unhurried look, the indigo eyes glowing.
formal: With the vanguard before the march: a long dark indigo wool coat that closes down the front with dull silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar, a slim black sash, the hair combed straight and gathered at the nape with a dark cord. She stands with her hands folded in front, a flat, level look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the indigo-violet eyes looking at the viewer with a calm, flat look, the mouth closed. Harsh white light from one side, from a tower far above, and on the other side a deep darkness from which a long shadow-hand reaches toward her shoulder. Foreground blur: dust and the edge of a broken wall-stone. She wears the dark slate-grey coat, the long hair falling out of the frame.
battle_old: Sending her shadow across the breach: the close dark coat belted tight with a black leather harness, black leather bracers, soft boots. Her shadow has left her and rises beside her as a long flat black silhouette of a woman taller than she is, its long thin fingers reaching forward; her own right hand is raised with the fingers spread, steering it, the left hand low at her side. A cold, intent, unhurried look, the indigo eyes glowing.
gear: 英雄（约LVL 186，名字凝住）｜中｜轻装无声｜4档｜跟塔赫尔同档的英雄，影魔走影子、不挂会响的东西，档用在吞光的哑黑曜片和贴身皮挽具上，不加重甲。

name: 埃梅里克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4208
who: Emeric, a human, commander of Crossing City on the southern wall and a former dragon-thunder cannon gunner, sixty-one and looking about forty: about 180 cm, solid and square-shouldered. Dark green short hair combed back. Pomegranate-red eyes. The outer half of his LEFT eyebrow was burnt away by a cannon's back-flash (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the right eyebrow whole. An old scar across the web of his RIGHT thumb from a cannon breech (on the viewer's left when he faces us). An old iron rail spike from the star-thread railway always sticks out of his coat pocket. Fair skin. A dry, factual, unbending air. No jewelry, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a firm, weathered face of a man of about forty: pomegranate-red, level eyes with a few fine lines at the corners; the LEFT eyebrow only a short inner stub, its outer half burnt away to bare skin (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the right eyebrow full and straight, the two brows must not match; a straight nose; a closed, level mouth; a square, clean-shaven jaw.
build: 180 cm, solid: square strong shoulders, thick forearms, a gunner's heavy hands.
palette: standard grey wool, dark green, pomegranate red, gunmetal, brass
casual: His everyday wear as wall commander: the standard grey wool coat, elbows thinned and cuffs scorched, buttoned over a plain linen shirt, a leather belt, grey trousers tucked into worn boots; the old iron rail spike sticks out of the right coat pocket. He holds a folded supply list in his right hand, the thumb scar showing, a dry, level look.
private: Off duty in his quarters: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves rolled, a dark wool waistcoat unbuttoned, grey trousers, soft shoes. He turns the old rail spike over in one hand, a tired, thinking look.
battle: Holding the rail crossing, in a wall commander's enchanted kit: the standard grey wool coat belted tight over a fitted steel half-cuirass cut with rune seams that glow pale blue, enchanted iron pauldrons with a lit crystal set in each, heavy leather cannoneer's gauntlets with brass crystal-feed rings at the wrists, a leather pouch of crystal cells at the belt, a leather cannoneer's cap with the ear flaps turned up, heavy boots; the old iron rail spike sticks out of the coat pocket. A plain broad straight sword hangs at his left hip in its scabbard; in his right hand he holds a long brass-capped cannon rammer upright like a staff, its brass cap etched with a glowing rune ring. A planted, unyielding stance, a hard, calculating look.
formal: At a wall muster: a clean, brushed grey wool coat with every button in place, a dark green sash across the chest, a small brass badge of a cannon muzzle at the collar, polished boots, the hair combed back neatly. He stands straight with his hands clasped behind him, a level, dry look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pomegranate-red eyes looking at the viewer with a level, unmoved look, the mouth closed, the burnt left eyebrow clear. Grey overcast daylight from one side, a warm brass glint from a cannon barrel behind. Foreground blur: drifting cinders and the rusty head of an old rail spike. He wears the standard grey wool coat.
battle_old: Holding the rail crossing: the grey wool coat belted tight over a dull steel breastplate cut with faint rune seams, iron shoulder plates, heavy leather gunner's gauntlets, a leather gunner's cap with the ear flaps turned up, heavy boots. A plain broad straight sword hangs at his left hip in its scabbard; in his right hand he holds a long brass-capped gunner's rammer upright like a staff. A planted, unyielding stance, a hard, calculating look.
gear: 极境｜中｜照常｜3档｜极境的段城守将，龙雷炮手出身，照浮塔年月灰外套罩附魔半身甲、晶匣皮袋那一身成套，招牌是刻符的炮杵和口袋里的旧道钉。

name: 哈尔赞
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4226
who: Harzan, a night-wing demon, a named hunter who leads a few hundred wings that chase the falling sky-towers, ninety-six years old and looking under forty: about 182 cm, lean, light-boned and long-armed. Black hair with a blue sheen tied back at the nape. Golden-orange eyes that glow at night. A pair of large deep indigo membrane wings like a bat's; on the membrane of the LEFT wing a patch of white scar where it burnt through and grew back, like a scatter of salt (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the right wing unmarked. A short pale whistle of vulture leg bone is always held in the corner of his mouth, NOT a cigarette. No horns, no jewelry. A dry, sharp air, always looking up.
build: 182 cm, lean and light: wiry shoulders, a long narrow torso, long arms.
palette: deep indigo, blue-black, golden orange, sand dun, bone white
casual: His wear at the edge of the sand sea: a sleeveless sand-dun linen jerkin wrapped and belted, open at the back between the wing roots, a long faded dun cloth wound loosely around the neck and shoulders, dark leather arm wraps, loose dark trousers bound at the ankle, soft wrapped boots. He stands looking up at the empty sky, the bone whistle in his mouth, a dry, intent look.
private: At his clan's fire: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt open at the back for the wings, the dun cloth around his shoulders, dark trousers, barefoot, the wings folded. He holds out a small scrap of torn, faded sky-tower flag in one hand as if letting a child touch it, a crooked, gentle look.
battle: Diving on the falling tower, in a night-wing hunter's war harness: dark scaled-leather flight armour over the dun jerkin, chest and shoulder plates of pale carved bone edged with polished black obsidian, a short mantle of dark vulture feathers at the shoulders, bone bracers carved with hunting script that glows dull gold, the back open between the wing roots, the great indigo membrane wings spread wide. He grips a long bone spear in both hands, its point ground to a needle and glinting gold along the carved script. A fierce, sharp, grinning look with the whistle clenched in his teeth.
formal: Before his clan's fire on a naming night: a long dark indigo wool coat that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, open at the back for the wings, a wide sand-dun sash, a narrow band of indigo cloth tied around the brow. He stands straight with the wings folded, a proud, dry look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the golden-orange eyes glowing as he looks up past the viewer at the sky, the bone whistle in the corner of his mouth. Cold white light from a sky-tower hanging far above, warm sand-orange light reflected from below. Foreground blur: blowing sand, a dark vulture feather and the indigo edge of a wing.
battle_old: Diving on the falling tower: dark scaled-leather flight armour over the dun jerkin, pale bone plates on the chest and shoulders, leather bracers, the back open between the wing roots, the great indigo membrane wings spread wide. He grips a long bone spear in both hands, its point glinting. A fierce, sharp, grinning look with the whistle clenched in his teeth.
gear: 英雄（约LVL 128）｜贫｜照常｜4档｜英雄低处，英雄往上不看家境；夜翼猎手扑塔，骨甲镶黑曜、鹫羽披肩、刻猎文的骨护臂，骨矛照旧，哨含在嘴里。

name: 托尔斯坦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4246
who: Torsten, a human, chief of the crystal-supply camp at the north end of the Glass Plain, fifty-two and looking about forty: short, about 166 cm, with broad shoulders and a thick body. Flax-gold short hair shot through with white. Deep blue eyes. He drags his LEFT leg, holding it stiff and putting his weight on the right (the left leg is on the viewer's right when he faces us). Fair skin with wind-reddened cheeks. A steady, counting, quietly stubborn air; he speaks in numbers. No jewelry, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a worn, square face of a man of about forty: deep blue eyes with fine lines at the corners; thick flax-gold eyebrows touched with white; a broad nose; a firm closed mouth with a deep line at each side; light stubble on a square jaw.
build: 166 cm, short and broad: wide shoulders, a thick chest and solid arms, a heavy-set body.
palette: standard grey wool, flax gold, deep blue, glass-sand pale, lantern amber
casual: His camp-chief wear: the standard grey wool coat, elbows thinned, over a thick wool shirt, a wide leather belt with a counting cord of knots hanging from it, grey trousers tucked into heavy boots, a sand-dun scarf at the neck. He stands with his weight on the right leg, holding a wax tally board, a level, counting look.
private: Off shift in the camp: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, a knitted grey vest, plain trousers, soft shoes. He carries a folded wool blanket over one arm, his weight on the right leg, a kind, tired look.
battle: Leading the crystal caravan north, in a camp chief's refitted issue gear: the grey wool coat belted over an old enchanted brigandine re-laced with new straps, one thin rune line glowing pale blue along its seams, a single crystal-set iron pauldron on the right shoulder, a leather pouch of crystal cells at the belt, a sand-dun hooded cloak, the scarf pulled up to the chin, heavy boots, a short straight sword at his left hip. He holds a lit brass crystal lantern up in his right hand, its pale blue light steady, his weight on the right leg, a steady, watchful look.
formal: At the camp muster: a clean brushed grey wool coat buttoned to the throat, a deep blue sash across the chest, polished boots, the hair combed. He stands as straight as his stiff left leg allows, the hands at his sides, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep blue eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, heavy look, the mouth closed. Hard noon light from straight above, and his crooked shadow falls away at a wrong angle on the glassy ground. Foreground blur: glittering glass sand and a row of lanterns lit toward the south. He wears the standard grey wool coat.
battle_old: Leading the crystal caravan north: the grey wool coat belted over a padded leather vest, a sand-dun hooded cloak, the scarf pulled up to the chin, heavy boots, a short straight sword at his left hip. He holds a lit brass lantern up in his right hand, his weight on the right leg, a steady, watchful look.
gear: 灵格（高处）｜中｜照常｜2档｜灵格高处的运晶驻地领头，营垒那一路的寻常人家，二档：灰外套底下一副重新上了带的旧附魔甲、一只镶晶的肩甲、晶匣皮袋，提灯换成晶灯。
